sections.text: Introduction

The 
VT12X time delay voltage relay is used in order to prevent an undesired increase 
or decrease of voltage in generators, power networks or electric devices

This procedure derails the steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration of the relay. It is 
recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases. The document is 
formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury 
or damage to equipment

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed 
 Bahie Abdel-Wanes, accepted by eng. Ragheb 
 Abd Raboh: general director, and approved by eng. Fathy 
 Mohamed Ibrahem: Head Sector of Siouf Power Station.

This document certified by 
eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer A and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Over Voltage Test

Disconnected the circuit 
breaker.

Remove the input voltage 
terminals (8,9) from the terminal board.

Connect test loads between 
terminal (8,9)

Increase the injected 
voltage until the red indication on the relay appears.

Record this value on the 
test sheet (adjust it if needed).
Switch off the set.

sections.text: Time Test

Connect the time delayed 
contact numbers (1,2) on the relay timer to timer terminals on the test set.

Start the test by 
injecting the pick up voltage value into the relay.

The timer will stop once 
the relay has pick up.

Record the value of time 
on the test sheet (adjust it if needed).

sections.text: Return Relay to Service

Disconnect the test leads 
from the terminal board and return the relay terminals (8,9) to normal condition

Disconnect the test leads 
from timer terminal on the relay and connect the relay timer contact to normal 
condition

If any equipment 
associated with the relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by 
the following restoration steps:-
Breaker trip coil
